details:
Implement a safety setting that would set all avatars to the completely blocked state (the eye with a slash through it) by default. 
This is so that you can then show someone's avatar while still respecting your safety settings. 
For example, you enter a public world, everyone has their avatar turned off because of the new setting. You show the avatars of some cool people you just met. Rather than completely showing them, which may have a performance impact on lower end hardware if they have flashy or complex avatars. Instead you can just click the show based on safety settings icon which will show what your safety settings allow (the current "default" setting). 
Essentially this would add an intermediate step between not shown at all, and shown completely. Currently the only way to get close to this is to put on maximum safety settings, which will hide everything by default. However you are forced to then completely show someone's avatar to see their avatar at all.

(I should mention that ideally you would never have to go into a world with maxed safety settings in the first place if proper anti-crash mechanisms were put in place. Either on the SDK or user side.)
title: "Block All Avatars by Default" Setting.
